title: 錆びた歯車と、嘘の吐けない乙女の遺言
author: 鉄屑 カノン

en.title: The Rusted Gear and the Maiden Who Can't Lie's Testament
en.premise: I, a scavenger who makes a living on a giant flying wreck, one day discovers a "lost letter" sealed inside a rusted brass box. The letter belongs to a steam‑doll girl cursed with the inability to lie, who uses the letter to convey an unspoken truth. It points to a legendary purification device said to lie beyond the clouds. With my foul‑mouthed partner, a mechanical mouse, I set out to slice through the rusted sky on a daring journey.

zh.title: 锈蚀齿轮与不说谎少女的遗嘱
zh.premise: 我是一名在巨型飞船废墟上生活的拾荒者，某天在一只锈蚀的黄铜盒子里发现了一封“失落的信”。这封信的主人是一位被诅咒不能说谎的蒸汽人形少女，她用信传递无法言说的真相。信中指向一台传说中隐藏在云层之外的净化装置。带着口无遮拦的伙伴——一只机械鼠，我踏上了切割锈蚀天空的冒险之旅。
